name: 05 Repositories and job branches
intro: How jobs work in repositories: the registry, AsmAI's own clone, workspaces and assignment branches, the job branch and its fast-forward on acceptance, keeping current, conflicts and outside commits, notes, the leaders' view, repository instructions, commit trailers and cleanup. One question is a conflict between AssemblyAI#11 and AssemblyAI#18; two come from silences. When you accept it I commit it and start 06 Validation and delivery.
notes: Rule 15 adds AssemblyAI#18's "the daemon is the only party that ever moves the job branch" to AssemblyAI#11's one-writer rule.

Rule 25 combines AssemblyAI#11 (fetch before every push; outside commits kept and merged) with AssemblyAI#18 (the daemon refuses the push, a worker merges the outside commits in, and the push is retried); 06 specifies the push itself.
Rule 37's last sentence is from AssemblyAI#18: repository instructions shape the PR and Quality's review, never how the branch is pushed.
The Codex skill folders and the clone's exclude file are specified in 08, and the no-CI declaration in 06; both are listed here only as per-repository settings and files.
